# Signature Scheme

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SignatureScheme`](gmeow-SignatureScheme.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SignatureScheme>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The cryptographic signature scheme used — a value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Distinct from [`gmeow:KeyScheme`](gmeow-KeyScheme.md): a key scheme names the key format (OpenPGP, X.509), while a signature scheme names the algorithm (RSA-SHA256, Ed25519).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SignatureScheme`](gmeow-SignatureScheme.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the cryptographic signature ALGORITHM — RSA-SHA256, Ed25519, ECDSA-secp256k1, BLS12-381 — naming the scheme a [`gmeow:CryptographicSignature`](gmeow-CryptographicSignature.md) was produced with.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-scheme subclasses (schemes are individuals) and avoid using it for the key FORMAT (that is [`gmeow:KeyScheme`](gmeow-KeyScheme.md) — OpenPGP, X.509); the signature scheme is the algorithm, not the key container.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`gmeow:SignatureScheme`](gmeow-SignatureScheme.md) individual from the signature via [`gmeow:signatureAlgorithm`](../properties/gmeow-signatureAlgorithm.md); mint new individuals as algorithms appear, and keep the key format on [`gmeow:KeyScheme`](gmeow-KeyScheme.md).

### Examples

- ex:sig1 [`gmeow:signatureAlgorithm`](../properties/gmeow-signatureAlgorithm.md) [`gmeow:signatureSchemeEd25519`](../individuals/gmeow-signatureSchemeEd25519.md).
